title: Revengeance is Minor, Part Red
description: Revengeance is Minor, Part Red — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Look for Halfassin White on Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill him and check in with [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Look for Halfassin White on Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill him and check in with [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

We can't let Halfassin Black get a higher kill score than me! You go through Level 1 from one direction, and I'll go in the other direction, and we'll catch him in a classic pincer maneuver. I just love a classic pincer maneuver, have I told you that?

Turn-in:

These two Halfassins are adorable. Thanks for keeping me up to date on their antics!

Objectives:

  • Kill Halfassin White

Level range: 51–61
